purpose: Describe an event that almost happened but was avoided.
keywords: V dictionary + ところだった
One more step and I would have fallen into the hole.
Without the notice, I would have gone to the station for nothing.
formation: V dictionary + ところだった
restrictions: Often paired with もう少しで, 危うく, or a counterfactual condition.
mistake: Context must distinguish a near miss from a literal stage of an action.
